scenes.title: The Hidden Doorway
scenes.narrative_text: High in his grandfather’s house, curious seven-year-old Pip pulled back an old velvet tapestry. Hidden behind it was a narrow staircase leading up to a Secret Attic Library! Glowing dust motes danced around towering wooden bookshelves filled with thousands of forgotten, leatherbound magical books.

scenes.title: A Mechanical Friend
scenes.narrative_text: Tucked away among the ancient scrolls perched a tiny brass Clockwork Owl. Pip leaned closer as its sapphire eyes clicked open. With a soft chime, the little owl fluttered its copper feathers and ruffled its whirring gears, greeting Pip with a cheerful chirp.

scenes.title: The Hovering Wonder
scenes.narrative_text: Suddenly, a bright shimmer caught Pip's eyes. Above the topmost shelf, a golden Floating Key danced in midair, drifting toward a stained-glass skylight. "We must catch it!" whispered Pip. That Floating Key held the magic to unlock the library’s secrets!
